prompt: The three example pairs show the same transformation applied to different objects. Infer the shared transformation from the examples, then apply it to the query image. Which candidate shows the result? Answer with exactly one letter: A, B, C, or D.
note: orientations are approximate (hand-rotated, visually checked keyframes); translations are crop-window shifts of recorded frames (camera-pan equivalent). Crops are placed from the object centres in keyframes.json so that the object's displacement relative to the reference image (demo 'before' / query) equals the intended shift (0 when there is no shift). Each question records its own crop window, shift, objects and generation seed.
